name: com.crawfissoftware.ugs
description:
A Unity Gaming Services integration expressed entirely as events: initialization, authentication and sign-in UI, remote config, leaderboards and achievements. The game and the services layer talk only through the GameSignals contract, so either side can be replaced - or removed - without the other noticing.

Contains no Asset Store content and no generated Cloud Code bindings, so it installs into any project without a prior import step.

REQUIRES com.crawfissoftware.eventspublisher, .common and .contracts. All three are distributed by git URL and therefore cannot be declared as resolvable dependencies here - add them to your project manifest yourself. See the README.

samples.description: The additive boot scenes for initialization, remote config, authentication, achievements and leaderboards, plus the achievement and leaderboard panels. Add the imported scenes to your build profile - they load one another by name.
